Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Access without the right (X2)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns no Treatment and offer right U for "RW-CASEOWN"
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002
    Then no record is written and nothing is read from rwb-case or rwb-decision

  Scenario: AC4 Required element absent (X3, BR12)
    Given the command has no value for one required element
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then nothing is written
    Then the system shows MSG-GEN-001 and names the field

  Scenario: AC5 Route above the limit (X4, BR1, BR2, BR15)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "ROUTE_D6" for "RC-2026-000408"
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the rule id, the rule version and a limit in force that the chosen route exceeds
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the approval is refused with its reason
    Then the case is routed to FEAT-VAL-09 and no approval is recorded

  Scenario: AC6 Override without a coded reason (X5, BR4, BR14)
    Given the chosen route differs from the recommended route
    Given the override reason is absent
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then nothing is written
    Then the coded reason is required and MSG-GEN-001 is shown

  Scenario: AC7 Case not at the route decision (X6, BR3)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns a state other than "ROUTE_D6" for "RC-2026-000408", or no recommendation on the case
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the step does not run and nothing is approved
    Then the state is reported to the parent workflow

  Scenario: AC8 Dependency does not answer in time (X7)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer inside 2 s
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow schedule
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees 503 in the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC9 Same approval submitted twice (X8, BR8, BR18)
    Given an approval is recorded under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same command is submitted again with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then one record and one answer exist and no second case move is made
    Then the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC10 Statement outside rwb_valuation (X9, BR6, BR9, BR10)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reads a recovery_case row, a v_ace_* view or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
    Then no event is published and nothing is released
